channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Rheumatoid arthritis pain may persist despite controlled inflammation
item.description: Pain and fatigue in rheumatoid arthritis can continue even after inflammation improves, linked to depression, poor sleep, obesity, smoking and chronic pain.

item.title: CRISPR treatment halves bad cholesterol for a full year
item.description: A single dose of an experimental CRISPR therapy reduced LDL cholesterol and triglycerides by about half in patients with a difficult-to-treat lipid disorder.

item.title: Glucosamine supplement tied to faster Alzheimer's progression
item.description: A large records analysis found glucosamine use was linked to a 25% higher likelihood of mild cognitive impairment advancing to dementia.

item.title: New soil test shows how microbes help feed plants
item.description: Scientists simplified a method to measure DNA-bound phosphorus in soil, cutting cost and effort while keeping accuracy.
